title: Odd showers.
content: Just realized I’ve had millions of dreams where there are showers in odd places. Like in the corner of the room and the floor is carpeted. Or, it’s in a regular bathroom but the shower head shoots out over the floor of the bathroom. Or I’m staying at someone’s house and have to walk really far to the shower and when I get there it’s messed up. Or weird camp type showers where it’s like a toilet shower. Just random odd showers popping up in my crazy mall world dreams.
